p1_findings: Only the watchdog normal path retries indefinitely; exception/signal and missing-ID paths can release serialization before absence.
No watchdog ready, source, pipe, lock or fork-identity gate precedes container work.
The separated mount still relies on umask-filtered mode 0777 rather than verified UID-1000 ownership.
Docker environment/client/socket, cgroups, image and full actual configuration remain insufficiently bound.
Docker command output remains unbounded and partial timeout streams are not retained.
Unbounded recovery also retains unbounded state and reuses an exclusive journal name after partial-write failure.
p2_findings: Writes/config transitions remain incomplete or non-additive and omit directory fsync.
The PASS predicate incompletely binds build outputs and mislabels decoded watchdog status as raw wait status.
